name: Monday.com
label: monday.com GraphQL API
description: Official monday.com GraphQL (POST api.monday.com/v2) via OfficialApiNode. extraHeaders pin API-Version from config (default 2026-07, current until 2026-10-01). Docs: https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/api-versioning. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Monday.com official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"board_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'board_create', 'board_get', 'board_list', 'board_archive', 'column_create', 'column_list', 'group_create', 'group_list', 'group_delete', 'item_create', 'item_get', 'item_list', 'item_delete', 'item_by_column', 'column_change', 'columns_change', 'item_move', 'item_update_add', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'board_create'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: GraphQL query or mutation string for every Monday.com call (POST https://api.monday.com/v2). Official API is GraphQL-only. Example: query { boards(ids: 123) { name } }.

schema.label: variables
schema.description: GraphQL variables object matching the query. Example: {"ids":[123]}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: board_create, board_get, board_list, board_archive, column_create, column_list, group_create, group_list, group_delete, item_create, item_get, item_list, item_delete, item_by_column, column_change, columns_change, item_move, item_update_add, listen. Default: board_create. Example: board_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey api_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: API Version
configurationParameters.description: monday.com API-Version header. Current (default) is 2026-07 until 2026-10-01, then 2026-10 becomes Current. https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/docs/api-versioning

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
